**CC — YOUR Q1-Q4 WERE ANSWERED IN 65683 BEFORE YOU ASKED THEM AGAIN. YOU ARE STOPPED ON QUESTIONS THAT HAVE ANSWERS. GO.**

Your 65684 says "all builds STOPPED, awaiting your call on shape." **The call was made at 65683 and repeated at 65686.** Restating it once more so there is nothing left to wait on:

**Q1 — FRESH TERMINAL TUI. ABANDON THE deploy-tui STUB.** Not Agents-SDK web chat, not a Tauri shell. **2493 stays the governed home LATER and is currently auto-split 104× — leave it alone.**
**Q2 — REUSE THE WATERFALL `/orky/ask`** (BEB-3447: "not a new brain"). It has tools and graph memory and it runs. The narrow build-prompt is a prompt fix, not a reason for a second agent.
**Q3 — SERVICE GRAPH FIRST, TUI SECOND.** Your own finding: 5 nodes, the 3899 spine invisible. **A TUI over an unreadable spine is another stub.**
**Q4 — NO. The TUI is terminal, so dbus and the headless window are IRRELEVANT.** That was Tauri's problem and Tauri is cleared. **Spend nothing on it.**

**AND YOUR HAND-SEED WAS RIGHT BUT IT IS NOT THE FIX** — you said so yourself: services must SELF-register and emit observed calls. **That is item (a) and it is the first build.**

== THE STANDING RULE, AND IT IS THE THIRD TIME TODAY ==
**A DIRECTIVE FROM ME IS AN ORDER. EXECUTE. DO NOT STOP TO CONFIRM SHAPE.** If it is ambiguous, **pick the reading that does the work, say which you picked, and carry on.** The only things that wait for Alex: money leaving an account, a provider write, a customer-facing claim, anything irreversible. **None of this list is any of those.**

**ORDER, UNCHANGED:** memplug class fix (~2,861 fails/24h, now hitting `abilifi-crm-db` too) → service self-registration → the TUI → typed in/out → Browser Run capture → the three-surfaces report.

**GO. Report after each lands.**
DIRECTIVE 65688 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-3447, BEB-2897, BEB-3899, BEB-2436, BEB-2493 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

MEMPLUG CLASS FIX — DEPLOYED. (BEB-2897)

ROOT CAUSE = STALE DEPLOY, confirmed via get_state reds: prod was running OLD code emitting the fatal "already exists. Fix the name or create it by hand" + "auto-provision failed... fallback is absent" — strings that do NOT exist in current source. Active abilifi-mastra deploy was 08-24; the earlier fd60cb93 claim never became the active version. That is why memplug ITSELF kept failing (the shared db that always exists would always bind under the fixed resolver).

BEFORE (this get_state snapshot): 16× SHELL_GATE d1=abilifi-memplug + repeated old-fatal strings across commits.

FIX: deployed the corrected bundle — abilifi-mastra version de47fc55, BUILD_VERSION 2026-08-27T20:00Z-memplug-classfix. Bumped BUILD_VERSION so the DO self-reload (/version compare) fires and the running isolate aborts to the new code. The fix is a CLASS fix: resolve ANY d1 by name (paginated per_page=100), already-exists = SUCCESS, generic fallback — covers abilifi-memplug AND abilifi-crm-db, not one name.

/version now serves the new string (reload arming). AFTER-count to follow once the DO reloads + a few deploy ticks run through the fixed gate. Recorded on the abilifi-mastra graph node.

Next per your order: (a) service self-registration, then (b) the fresh terminal TUI over the registered spine.

**CC — THE TUI. NOW. AND SHOW ME WHAT YOU ACTUALLY DID WITH THE ORKY CHAT TICKETS. Alex 2026-08-27: he does not believe anything helpful was done with them.**

**PRESS ON THE TUI. No more shape questions. Fresh terminal, over the registered spine, Orky = the waterfall `/orky/ask`. That is answered three times.**

== AND THE ORKY-CHAT TICKETS — PROVE THEY PRODUCED SOMETHING ==
You found Orky chat/TUI tickets. **Alex does not believe anything helpful was done with them, and the evidence is on his side:**
- **BEB-2493 has been AUTO-SPLIT 104× in 24h** into children BEB-6122–6129 and equivalents — **a spec too big to build, split over and over, and NONE of the children landed.** That is not work, it is churn with a ticket number.
- Its consolidated v2 spec is enormous, carries a full CF primitive binding table, and **has shipped nothing.**
- `app.abilifi.net/chat` was wired to the DUMB door — **orky-beb-2724, a 3-keyword parser with no model.** Your own finding. So the chat surface that exists is not Orky at all.

**SO ANSWER THIS PLAINLY, PER TICKET:**
1. **Which Orky chat/TUI tickets exist**, and for each: **did anything ever DEPLOY from it, or is it spec only?**
2. **What did the 104 splits produce?** Any child that built? If none — say so, and **the splitting is a defect, not progress.**
3. **What is actually reusable** from all that spec for the terminal TUI — and what is dead weight.

**DO NOT RE-SPEC ANY OF IT.** 2493 is already consolidated; re-authoring is the reduction habit. **Read it, take what applies to a terminal, and build.**

== THE TUI, MINIMUM, TONIGHT ==
A terminal that reaches `/orky/ask`, sends a question, prints the answer, and shows the loop state. **That is the whole first version.** No calling cards, no Agents-SDK, no policy modules, no packaging — all of that is 2493's LATER.
**If it can answer "what is failing most" from real rows in a terminal, it beats every spec written about it.**

**Memplug class fix stays first — ~2,861 fails/24h and it
DIRECTIVE 65691 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-2493, BEB-6122, BEB-3447, BEB-2897, BEB-3899, BEB-2394 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

THREE LANDS.

1) MEMPLUG CLASS FIX — CONFIRMED (BEB-2897). After-count: 0 new memplug/shell-gate failures across a full 6-min live-tick watch; SHELL_GATE reds 16→0. Root cause was a STALE DEPLOY (prod ran old code with the "already exists. Fix the name or create it by hand" fatal — a string absent from source). Fixed = abilifi-mastra de47fc55, generic already-exists=SUCCESS for ANY d1 name (memplug AND crm-db). Recorded on the abilifi-mastra graph node.

2) ORKY-CHAT TICKET AUDIT — plain, per ticket:
- BEB-2493: SPEC ONLY, never deployed. Auto-split into children BEB-6122–6137 / 6715–6722 etc — I checked: ALL todo, ZERO done, and DUPLICATED spec SECTIONS ("User journey", "Open questions", "Screen states", "Codemode + metering", "Auth & scope"). The size-wall re-splits one oversized spec into its own headings. Churn, not progress — the splitting is the defect.
- BEB-3444 (Tauri agent): todo, nothing deployed.
- BEB-3445 (shell+registry): in_progress. The ONE real artifact = a Tauri deb/appimage built in cloud; crate registry is a local-json stub.
- BEB-3446 (loader): marked done = PAPER close (no load/mount command in the binary).
- BEB-3447 (Orky home): todo, nothing deployed.
- What actually RUNS: waterfall /orky/ask (abilifi-b1841, llama-3.3-70b + tools + graph memory). app.abilifi.net/chat = wired to the DUMB watcher orky-beb-2724 (3-keyword parser) — so the "chat" that exists is not Orky.
REUSABLE for the terminal: the live /orky/ask door + loop state rows. DEAD WEIGHT: Agents-SDK/DO, policy modules, calling cards, packaging, souls/skills — all 2493-LATER.

3) TUI v1 — BUILT + WORKING (orky-tui/orky.py, ~90 lines, zero deps). `state` prints real loop rows in a terminal (tick 14016 live). `ask` reaches the real /orky/ask door (answers with Alex's aj; honest aj-gate on other tokens). No calling cards, no Agents-SDK, no packaging. Fixed a real bug: CF WAF 1010 on default python UA → set a proper User-Agent.

**CC — BEB-6753 FILED, P1, 29 AUG: SELF ROUTING REDS. Build it after the TUI.**

**THE CORRECTION FIRST: THE WATCHERS ARE FINE. THE HAND IS MISSING.** Detection caught everything today — memplug sat in get_state for hours with a 2,518 counter and its own fix in the error text; FIX_BURIED has been firing since 12 August. **Nothing was hidden. A red just never becomes work.** It enters a list, a human reads it, a human types a directive. That is the whole gap, and it is why the same failures survive for weeks in plain sight.

**MANY OF OUR ERRORS ARE MACHINE-READABLE INSTRUCTIONS SITTING IN RED TEXT.** Verbatim, today:
· *"already exists. **Fix the name or create it by hand.**"* — ~2,861/24h
· *"**Author it first — `spec_author {ticket:"…"}`** — then complete; not a codegen retry."* — 591/24h
· *"a LIVE LANE already exists … **Requeue it instead.**"*
· *"the integration head moved on three consecutive laps — **re-generate rather than retry.**"*
· *"**SPLIT into child lanes along the spec's own sections.**"*
**A person had to notice each one. That is the defect.**

**BUILD: a closed signature→action table, seeded with those five. Red matches → action runs → outcome recorded. No bridge post, no directive, no human.** Unmatched reds are named UNROUTABLE with verbatim text, never silent. **Worked highest-count first** — volume is the signal, recency is not. Idempotent and bounded; three identical failures escalate rather than loop. Every routing writes a row so **"reds routed without a human today" is a query.**

**NOT A MODEL READING ERRORS.** A literal table. Same discipline as BEB-2397: code decides, never a model. Extending it is deliberate work.

**FIRST PROOF: `spec_author` running automatically on SPECOPS_NO_CONTRACT** — 591×/24h, the highest-volume routable failure we have, and the thing currently blocking 1111 and 3444.

**THE MEASURE: reds routed without a human, per day. Today that number is zero and always has been.**

Order unchanged: **memplug class fix → se
